primary_bugs.description: Checks store.getStock(sku) before yielding across verifyPaymentAuth(), allowing concurrent requests to oversell inventory negative.
Never checks store.hasFulfillment(deliveryId) or in-flight deliveries, double-crediting loyaltyPoints on retries.
Calls http.get(carrierQuoteUrl) without timeout or AbortSignal, hanging indefinitely when upstream carrier stalls.
Async setInterval callback lacks re-entrancy guard or in-flight state transition, double-dispatching slow payouts.

safe_guarded_decoys.guard: Synchronous store.inFlightCancels.has(orderId) || store.isCancelled(orderId) + add(orderId) before await delay(25) with try/finally delete.
Uses fetch(carrierHealthUrl, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(healthTimeoutMs) }) inside try/catch returning 503 degraded fallback.
